# Gustavo Levandowski

> Gustavo Levandowski is a Senior Android Engineer and Google-certified Android Enterprise Expert based in Blumenau, Brazil. He is a technical reference for Android at scale and for programming careers, founder of LeCode mentoring, and founder of Levandowski (Levandowski Desenvolvimento de Software), a technology company for senior Android, secure mobile and AI-assisted delivery.

Gustavo has written software since 2013 and built Android products since 2017. He holds seven Google Android Enterprise certifications (through Expert) and has engineered systems used by platforms protecting more than one million corporate devices. He also cofounded Local Chat, a product that reached 20K+ users. Works remotely, worldwide, in English and Brazilian Portuguese.
